name: Button
description: Triggers an action or submits a form. Label is passed as projected content: <ds-button>Save</ds-button>.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style of the button (@Input).

props.name: size
props.description: Controls height and horizontal padding (@Input).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents interaction and dims the button (@Input).

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and blocks repeated clicks (@Input).

props.name: type
props.description: Native button type; use 'submit' inside forms (@Input).

props.name: clicked
props.description: Emits when the button is clicked (@Output).

a11y: Use a visible text label. If icon-only, set `aria-label`.

name: Input
description: Single-line text field for collecting user input. Supports two-way binding with [(value)].

props.name: value
props.description: Current value of the field (@Input).

props.name: valueChange
props.description: Emits the new value when the user types; enables [(value)] two-way binding (@Output).

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label rendered above the field (@Input).

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint shown while the field is empty (@Input).

props.name: type
props.description: Native input type (@Input).

props.name: error
props.description: Error message; also switches the field to the error style (@Input).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents editing and dims the field (@Input).

a11y: Always provide `label`; do not rely on `placeholder` alone. Error messages are linked to the field with `aria-describedby`.

name: Card
description: Container that groups related content on a raised surface. Body is projected content; actions go in an element with the `footer` attribute.

props.name: title
props.description: Optional heading shown at the top of the card (@Input).

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Optional secondary line under the title (@Input).

props.name: padding
props.description: Inner spacing of the card (@Input).

props.name: elevated
props.description: Adds a shadow instead of a flat border (@Input).

props.name: bordered
props.description: Draws a 1px border around the card (@Input).

a11y: A card is not interactive by itself. If the whole card is clickable, wrap it in a link or button rather than adding a click handler.

name: Badge
description: Small label that shows a status or count. Text is passed as projected content.

props.name: tone
props.description: Color meaning of the badge (@Input).

props.name: size
props.description: Controls text size and padding (@Input).

props.name: pill
props.description: Uses fully rounded corners (@Input).

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Shows a close button on the badge (@Input).

props.name: dismissed
props.description: Emits when the close button is clicked (@Output).

a11y: Do not convey status by color alone; the text must state the status. For live counts, wrap the badge in an element with `aria-live="polite"`.

name: Modal
description: Dialog that overlays the page and requires the user to respond. Body is projected content; actions go in an element with the `footer` attribute.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the modal is visible (@Input).

props.name: closed
props.description: Emits on Escape, backdrop click or the close button; the parent should set `open` to false (@Output).

props.name: title
props.description: Heading of the dialog, also used as its accessible name (@Input).

props.name: size
props.description: Maximum width of the dialog (@Input).

props.name: closeOnBackdrop
props.description: Whether clicking the backdrop closes the modal (@Input).

example:
This cannot be undone.
Delete
a11y: Focus moves into the dialog on open and is trapped until it closes, then returns to the trigger. Always provide `title` so the dialog has an accessible name.
